## Endpoints Acessíveis com JWT
- `GET /api/auth/me` → 200 (dados do usuário)
- `GET /api/playlists` → 200 (lista de playlists)
- `GET /api/plans` → 200 (planos)
- `POST /api/auth/register` → 200 (criar conta)
- `POST /api/auth/login` → 200 (login)

## Endpoints Admin (401 AUTH_REQUIRED — precisam de role admin)
- `/api/admin/users`, `/api/admin/heroes`, `/api/admin/revenue/overview`
- `/api/admin/discord/stats`, `/api/admin/crons/status`, `/api/admin/quota/stats`
- `/api/admin/verify`, `/api/admin/playlists/debug`
- `/api/admin/providers/*`, `/api/admin/tv-scheduler/*`
- `/api/admin/push/*`, `/api/admin/recommendations/*`
